messages.subject: Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMMs) in R online course (4th edition)
messages.subject_clean: Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMMs) in R online course (4th edition)
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

We are excited to announce the 4th edition of our Generalized Linear Mixed Models (GLMMs) in R online course, taking place September 21–24..

For more information and to register, please visit:
https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-work/glmms-in-r

This course is designed for graduate students and researchers with experience in generalized linear models who want to deepen their skills to analyze complex grouped and correlated data. You will learn to specify, interpret, and validate GLMMs using the R packages lme4 and glmmTMB, along with hands-on training on model diagnostics and assumption checking using DHARMa.

The basics of linear models (LM), generalized linear models (GLM), and ANOVA are reviewed at the start of the course. However, if you do not have a solid understanding of these topics, you may benefit more from our course “Generalized Linear Models as a Unified Framework for Data Analysis in R,” also offered by Physalia: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/glm-in-r-1/

Best regards,

Carlo

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D

Physalia-courses DIRECTOR

in...@physalia-courses.org

messages.body_plain:
From: Torbjørn Håkan Ergon <t.h....@ibv.uio.no>
Sent: Saturday, February 28, 2026 12:02
Subject: 2 PhD + 2 postdoc fellowships in ecology, statistics and philosophy

Dear all,

Please help to spread this to relevant candidates:

As part of a new interdisciplinary ‘Convergence Environment’ at UiO:LifeScience, we are seeking applicants for four fully funded positions:

PhD fellowship in statistical population ecology <https://www.jobbnorge.no/en/available-jobs/job/294034/phd-research-fellow-in-statistical-population-ecology> (application deadline 15 April)
PhD fellowship in statistics <https://www.jobbnorge.no/en/available-jobs/job/294742/phd-research-fellow-in-statistics> (application deadline 1 March – NB!)
Postdoc fellowship in spatial ecological modeling and interdisciplinary biodiversity science <https://www.jobbnorge.no/en/available-jobs/job/293410/postdoctoral-researcher-in-spatial-ecological-modeling-and-interdisciplinary-biodiversity-science> (deadline 8 April)
Postdoc fellowship in applied philosophy (nature management and governance) (to be announced)

The convergence environment brings together researchers and students from the departments of Biosciences, Mathematics (Statistics), Philosophy, as well at the Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo, Norway. The overarching goal of the project is to develop and apply (statistical) models to support efficient nature management and governance. For more information, see https://www.uio.no/english/research/str ... ents/biom/ <https://www.uio.no/english/research/strategic-research-areas/life-science/research/convergence-environments/biom/>.

Cheers,

Torbjørn Ergon

Centre for Ecological and Evolutionary Synthesis

University of Oslo
